name: @mymcp/root
description: TypeScript monorepo for independently maintained MCP servers

scripts.console:dev: pnpm --filter @mymcp/mcp-client... build && pnpm --filter @mymcp/example... build && pnpm --filter @mymcp/dcinside build && CONSOLE_HOST=127.0.0.1 CONSOLE_PORT=3000 CONSOLE_ALLOWED_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:5173 CONSOLE_SECURE_COOKIES=false CONSOLE_DATA_DIR=./data pnpm --parallel --filter @mymcp/console-server --filter @mymcp/console-web dev
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mymcp/shared build && vitest run scripts/create-mcp.test.ts && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present run test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @mymcp/shared build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
